## Urban Built-up Area

### WSF Evolution 

```{r}
#| label: setup-wsf
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/wsf/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  USE_GCS <<- FALSE
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-wsf
#| include: false
# WSF Evolution — standardize to cumulative_sq_km
wsf <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_wsf_evolution.csv")), col_types = "dd") %>%
    rename(year = 1) %>%
    rename(cumulative_sq_km = any_of(c("AREA_sq_km", "cumulative sq km", "cumulative_sq_km"))) %>%
    mutate(growth_pct = (cumulative_sq_km / lag(cumulative_sq_km) - 1), growth_km2 = cumulative_sq_km - lag(cumulative_sq_km))
}, error = function(e) { message("WSF Evolution not available: ", e$message); NULL })

# WSF Tracker — standardize to cumulative_sq_km
wsf_tracker <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_wsf_tracker.csv")), col_types = "cdd") %>%
    mutate(date = if ("month" %in% names(.)) zoo::as.yearmon(paste(.data$year, .data$month, sep = "-")) else zoo::as.yearmon(.data$year)) %>%
    rename(cumulative_sq_km = any_of(c("AREA_sq_km", "cumulative sq km", "cumulative_sq_km"))) %>%
    mutate(growth_pct = (cumulative_sq_km / lag(cumulative_sq_km) - 1), growth_km2 = cumulative_sq_km - lag(cumulative_sq_km))
}, error = function(e) { message("WSF Tracker not available: ", e$message); NULL })

# WSF Harmonized — read raw CSV as-is
wsf_harm <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_wsf_harmonized.csv")), col_types = "ddcd")
}, error = function(e) { message("WSF Harmonized not available: ", e$message); NULL })
```

```{r}
#| label: WSF-Evolution
#| results: asis

if (is.null(wsf) || nrow(wsf) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No WSF file available")) else {
  uba_plot <- wsf %>%
    ggplot +
    geom_line(aes(x = year, y = cumulative_sq_km)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(1985, 2020, 5),
      minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2021, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, max(wsf$cumulative_sq_km)), expand = c(0, NA)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Built-up area expansion, 1985–2015",
         y = bquote('Urban built-up area,'~km^2)) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"))
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-uba-plot.png"), plot = uba_plot, device = "png",
         width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(uba_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  first_area <- wsf$cumulative_sq_km[1]
  latest_area <- tail(wsf$cumulative_sq_km, 1)
  first_year <- wsf$year[1]
  latest_year <- tail(wsf$year, 1)
  pct_growth <- 100 * (latest_area - first_area)/first_area

  print_text(paste0("\nThe city's built-up area grew from ", paste_bold(round(first_area, 2)), " km² in ", first_year, " to ", paste_bold(round(latest_area, 2)), " in ", paste_bold(latest_year), " for ", paste_bold(round(pct_growth, 2)), "% growth"))

  print_paged_df(wsf)
}
```

### WSF Tracker

```{r}
#| label: wsf-tracker
#| results: asis

if (is.null(wsf_tracker) || nrow(wsf_tracker) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No WSF tracker file available")) else {
  uba_tracker_plot <- wsf_tracker %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_line(aes(x = date, y = cumulative_sq_km)) +
    scale_x_yearmon(breaks = 2016.5 + 0:4*2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Built-up area expansion, 2016–2025",
         y = bquote('Urban built-up area,'~km^2)) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank())
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-uba-tracker-plot.png"), plot = uba_tracker_plot, device = "png",
         width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(uba_tracker_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  first_area <- wsf_tracker$cumulative_sq_km[1]
  latest_area <- tail(wsf_tracker$cumulative_sq_km, 1)
  first_date <- wsf_tracker$date[1]
  latest_date <- tail(wsf_tracker$date, 1)
  pct_growth <- 100 * (latest_area - first_area)/first_area
  print_text(paste0("\nThe city's built-up area grew from ", paste_bold(round(first_area, 2)), " km² in ", paste_bold(first_date), " to ", paste_bold(round(latest_area, 2)), " in ", paste_bold(latest_date), " for ", paste_bold(round(pct_growth, 2)), "% growth"))

  print_paged_df(wsf_tracker)
}
```

### WSF Harmonized

```{r}
#| label: wsf-harmonized
#| results: asis

if (is.null(wsf_harm) || nrow(wsf_harm) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No WSF harmonized file available")) else {

  # Plot 1: Evolution + Tracker as separate lines
  separate_data <- wsf_harm %>% filter(source %in% c("WSF Evolution (masked)", "WSF Tracker"))

  uba_separate_plot <- separate_data %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_line(aes(x = year, y = cumulative_sq_km, color = source, linetype = source)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 5),
      minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("WSF Evolution (masked)" = "#2166ac", "WSF Tracker" = "#b2182b")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("WSF Evolution (masked)" = "dashed", "WSF Tracker" = "dashed")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Built-up area expansion, 1985–2025 (separate sources)",
         y = bquote('Urban built-up area,'~km^2),
         x = "Year",
         color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom")

      
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-uba-separate-plot.png"), plot = uba_separate_plot, device = "png",
         width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(uba_separate_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  # Plot 2: Harmonized connected line
  harmonized_data <- wsf_harm %>% filter(source == "WSF Harmonized")

  if (nrow(harmonized_data) > 0) {
    uba_harm_plot <- harmonized_data %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_line(aes(x = year, y = cumulative_sq_km)) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 5),
        minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = "Built-up area expansion, 1985–2025",
           y = bquote('Urban built-up area,'~km^2),
           x = "Year") +
      theme(
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"))
    ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-uba-harmonized-plot.png"), plot = uba_harm_plot, device = "png",
           width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")
    print(uba_harm_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
    cat("\n\n")

    first_area <- harmonized_data$cumulative_sq_km[1]
    latest_area <- tail(harmonized_data$cumulative_sq_km, 1)
    first_year <- harmonized_data$year[1]
    latest_year <- tail(harmonized_data$year, 1)
    pct_growth <- 100 * (latest_area - first_area)/first_area

    print_text(paste0("\nThe city's built-up area grew from ", paste_bold(round(first_area, 2)), " km² in ", first_year, " to ", paste_bold(round(latest_area, 2)), " in ", paste_bold(latest_year), " for ", paste_bold(round(pct_growth, 2)), "% growth"))

    # Plot 3: Growth rate (3-year rolling average)
    smooth_window <- 3
    growth_data <- harmonized_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(growth_percentage)) %>%
      mutate(growth_smooth = zoo::rollmean(growth_percentage, k = smooth_window, fill = NA, align = "center"))

    uba_growth_plot <- growth_data %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_line(aes(x = year, y = growth_smooth)) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 5),
        minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste0("Urban Growth Rate (", smooth_window, "-year average)"),
           y = "Growth Rate (%)",
           x = "Year") +
      theme(
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"))
    ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-growth-rate-plot.png"), plot = uba_growth_plot, device = "png",
           width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")
    print(uba_growth_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  } else {
    print_text(paste_bold("No 'WSF Harmonized' source in CSV — re-run wsf_harmonize.py"))
  }

  print_paged_df(wsf_harm)
}
```
